cases.rationale: An actual rail vehicle with a recognizable front, windows and rail setting is visible at the station. The surrounding tracks, overhead wires, poles, platform and unpotted vegetation do not establish any other defined object. No identifiable person or separate traffic-signal head is visible. I considered each of the 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A woman stands among individual metal patio chairs and round eating tables; an umbrella canopy is visible at upper right. The dark fabric on the foreground chair looks like clothing rather than an identifiable bag. The small yellow smiley-faced round item she displays could be a decorated plate or an iced baked item; its detail does not resolve donut or cake identity, so both food categories remain unclear. A tiny object near her raised hand lacks enough detail to resolve fork versus spoon, leaving both unclear. I considered all 75 definitions; the other listed categories have no supporting actual object.

The crop shows browned irregular fritter or patty-like food on broad lettuce leaves, with a little purple onion and a white plate edge. These are not identifiable bread-supported sandwiches, pizza, cake or any of the named fruits or vegetables. The greens have leaf structure rather than broccoli florets, and the plate is not a bowl. I considered each of the 75 definitions and found no actual qualifying category object and no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real dark cat with visible eyes, ears, whiskers and forelegs sits beside a bear-shaped plush toy with stitched features and padded paws. The plush is teddy bear, not actual bear. Its printed shirt is not a necktie or a separate represented object. The plain surface and background do not identify a bed, couch or other listed furniture. I considered all 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual tabby cat stands on a window ledge between wooden shutters. Its head, striped body and legs establish cat identity. The shutters, window panes and reflected greenery do not establish other listed objects; in particular there is no plant-and-pot combination. I considered each of the 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The fuselage, wings, jet engines, tail and landing gear identify an actual passenger airplane. Ground workers with visible human bodies stand beside it. The low ground-service carts and equipment do not have identifiable passenger-car or road-truck structure. Building panels and aircraft markings do not count as represented objects. I considered all 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual speckled bird stands with its feet on a food-smeared flat plate. Crossed silver utensils include identifiable fork tines and a broad table-knife blade. A further rounded reflective utensil portion could be a spoon bowl but overlap prevents a determinate spoon identification, so spoon remains unclear. The residue and small yellow food pieces do not identify any named food category, and the plate is not a bowl. I considered all 75 definitions.

A real man holding a crumpled brown paper package is visible in front of the shop, with other people behind him. A large road bus with broad dark windows and a pale body is partly visible along the right edge. The paper package does not establish a handbag or a particular food, and the shop signs and printed merchandise pictures are excluded representations. No actual chair or eating tabletop is identifiable in the crop. I considered each of the 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

An open laptop has its integrated screen and keyboard visible; the laptop keyboard also satisfies keyboard, while the screen is excluded from standalone TV. A white computer mouse sits to its right, a small round clock is behind it, and a tall labeled bottle with neck/cap is at the upper right. A partially cropped white drinking cup is at the left edge. This is a work desk covered with loose papers, not a dining table; the pinned pictures and loose sheets do not establish actual books or depicted objects. I considered all 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The crop is filled with actual small orange citrus fruits with dimpled orange skins and attached green leaves, partly dusted with white snow. They identify orange fruit rather than apples or merely orange-colored objects. Loose leaves and fruit do not identify a growing potted plant, and no container is visible. I considered each of the 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A quilt-covered bed with its dark supporting frame fills the room, and a wall-mounted washbasin is visible above it. An open white bowl sits at lower right. The cropped white vessel at lower left could be a drinking cup or another bowl, so cup remains unclear. The old dark latched box at upper left may be travel luggage but lacks decisive suitcase context, leaving suitcase unclear. The dark frame behind the bed and towel could belong to a chair or a rack, leaving chair unclear. I considered all 75 definitions; there is no identifiable oven, refrigerator, toilet or dining-table context.

An actual silver rail train travels across the elevated steel structure, and small human figures are visible at street level near the bottom. The tiny pale road vehicle portions at lower left do not resolve passenger-car versus truck identity, leaving both categories unclear. A small upright street fixture near the lower right could be a parking meter but lacks sufficient detail, so parking meter remains unclear. No identifiable traffic-signal lamp assembly is visible. Billboard pictures, text and the painted elevated structure do not establish other category objects. I considered each of the 75 definitions.
